name: Get Lead Activities
summary: Pulls activity history (page views, email opens/clicks, form fills, changes, and more) after a given point in time. The core 'what did people do' data pull.
whenToUse: To export or inspect what leads did over a period. First run 'Get Paging Token' for your start date, then use its token here. Use the nextPageToken from each response to keep paging until moreResult is false.

query.name: nextPageToken
query.label: Paging token
query.hint: Get one from 'Get Paging Token' (for a start date) or copy it from a previous response to continue paging.

query.name: activityTypeIds
query.label: Only these activity types
query.hint: Optional. Up to 10 activity type IDs, comma-separated (get them from 'Get Activity Types'). Leave blank for all types.

query.name: leadIds
query.label: Only these leads
query.hint: Optional. Up to 30 lead IDs, comma-separated, to restrict the results.

query.name: listId
query.label: Only leads in this static list
query.hint: Optional. Restrict to activities of leads in one static list. Note: from late 2026 this fails on lists with 10,000+ leads.

response.description: Up to 300 activities per page: leadId, activityDate, activityTypeId, primaryAttributeValue, attributes[]. 'moreResult' + 'nextPageToken' indicate more pages.

notes: Returns up to 300 items per page — keep paging with the returned nextPageToken until moreResult is false.
From late 2026, the 'listId' option fails (error 1003) when the list has 10,000+ leads — scope to leadIds or use a Bulk Extract instead.
